finding.title: The `GetWindowTextA` function is used to retrieve the window text, but it does not check if the buffer is large enough to hold the text.
The `processName` buffer is declared but not initialized before being used.
The code does not handle errors that may occur during the execution of `GetWindowTextA`.
The code does not perform any security checks on the process name.
